# HtmlViewRun <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HtmlViewRun:Void htmlview:Int32, URL:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htmlview` | In | Int32 | required | The handle from [CreateHtmlView](CreateHtmlView). |
| `URL` | In | String | required | The script to run. |

## Description

Runs a script in the page of the gadget.

## Differences

* The script is not run, as there is no page.
